coordinates: Zero-based half-open. genomic_position starts a six-base token.
optional_annotation_columns: annotation_NAME as boolean or 0/1; bimodal_support counts distinct reference donors

annotation_sources.promoter: GENCODE v50 GRCh38.p14; strand-specific TSS minus 2 kb to plus 500 bp
annotation_sources.ccre_pls: ENCODE SCREEN Registry v4 promoter-like cCREs
annotation_sources.ccre_pels: ENCODE SCREEN Registry v4 proximal enhancer-like cCREs
annotation_sources.ccre_dels: ENCODE SCREEN Registry v4 distal enhancer-like cCREs
annotation_sources.regulatory_union: Promoters and all SCREEN cCRE classes
annotation_sources.bimodal: Rosenski et al. 2025, DOI 10.1038/s41467-025-57433-1, Supplementary Data 1; retain hg19 catalog boundaries

mapping: Both token endpoints map uniquely to the same chromosome and strand, with mapped span <= 20 bp. Failed mappings count as outside. Exclude target-donor support.
